item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's get started. It's the weekend. No school today! Welcome to your weather report for Saturday, October 24. Saturday! No school and no hurry today. Looking outside in Shanghai, today will be thundery. The high will be 22 degrees, and the low will be 19 degrees. A mild sort of day, easy to be outside in. The chance of rain is 100 percent. It's a blowy one out there today. The sun goes down at 5:13 this evening, about 2 minutes earlier than yesterday. Can you feel the days getting shorter? Pack your umbrella and your wellies! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be a little bit rainy, with a high of 22 degrees. A question for you: what is something you are really good at? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
